svg.title: qa-platformFE — web console architecture
svg.text: Application shell — the rings that may import every feature
features — 12 modules, each api / components / hooks / lib / pages / types
31 routed feature pages + the public landing page
Data flow — server state never lives in components
Boundaries enforced by lint (eslint-plugin-boundaries, default: disallow)
RootLayout · AppLayout · Sidebar · NavDrawer · AppBar · PageHeader*
useBreadcrumb · the only ring allowed to import any feature
Global dashboard leaves the customer sidebar (DSH-02)
Notification bell shows real deliveries or is removed (NTF-03)
Organisation settings and audit view for the org administrator
(SET-01, AUD-05) · Report-issue link only where a URL is set
step mapper, sync jobs, feature import
no pages — embedded in five screens
api/client.ts: axios, baseURL from env · interceptors:
hooks: debounce, countdown, status label, window class
i18n: en, es, fr — 2,517 keys each, held equal by a test
Pages and components never import an api module or the client (no-restricted-imports); a hook does.
project → auth, execution, scenario, imports, assistant · execution → auth, project, assistant
scenario → auth, project, catalog, execution, assistant · catalog → auth, project, assistant
imports → auth, project, scenario, catalog, execution · dashboard → auth, project, onboarding
overlay → auth, project, execution, catalog, assistant · assistant → auth, overlay (types only)
project must never import overlay · assistant owns every AI proposal concern
Vitest: ~1,640 tests in 219 files, coverage gate
Playwright mocked: 7 specs, fail on any unmocked /api
(G13) incl. axe WCAG 2.1 AA and reflow 320–1,440 px
Playwright real stack: overlay, TestRail, Xray Cloud
Docker: nginx on 8080, security headers + CSP (G22)
Image built by qa-platformBE deploy.yml at fe.ref
Decided: E2E on Firefox and WebKit too (NFR-12)
React 18 · TypeScript · Vite · TanStack Query · Zustand · i18next · Tailwind · 43,200 lines of TypeScript under src/ (tests excluded)
Verified against the code on 2026-10-20 · dashed = decided in alcance.md, not built
